mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2C8 inducer that may increase metabolism of risedronate and reduce its bioavailability, though risedronate is primarily eliminated renally with minimal hepatic metabolism.
action: Monitor for reduced bisphosphonate efficacy; consider alternative antimycobacterial agent if possible, or ensure adequate separation of dosing (risedronate on empty stomach, rifampin at different time) and monitor bone markers.
